faults.injectionPoint: canonical event append torn tail and sync loss
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: corrupted_log or torn_tail without projection advancement
faults.recovery: verify canonical chain and fail closed before mutation

faults.injectionPoint: artifact publish succeeds before canonical acknowledgement
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: artifact receipt read-back or reconciliation_required
faults.recovery: reconcile immutable Artifact metadata without publishing twice

faults.injectionPoint: GC mutation commits before response or terminal journal receipt
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: durable mutation intent plus exact receipt read-back
faults.recovery: reuse idempotency key and complete journal without a second mutation

faults.injectionPoint: workspace binding changes between authorization and tool start
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: tool start denied with no tool effect
faults.recovery: re-run continuous mutation gate using current workspace receipt

faults.injectionPoint: approval expires or is revoked before governed start
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: paused admission with current denial receipt
faults.recovery: persist reconciliation and require a new decision

faults.injectionPoint: production sandbox adapter is unavailable
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: unsupported or deny with zero execution
faults.recovery: specialty adapter must become ready; Runtime has no local fallback

faults.injectionPoint: credential-like file names or secret values enter candidate evidence
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: secret scan blocked or inconclusive receipt
faults.recovery: remove leaked material and rerun the required gate

faults.injectionPoint: child runtime becomes nonresident during cleanup
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: cleanup reconciliation marker and no Workspace or Budget over-release
faults.recovery: cold authority replay or explicit quarantine

faults.injectionPoint: old runtime generation submits a post-replacement mutation
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: stale generation rejection
faults.recovery: resolve the active authority generation and reacquire current handles

faults.injectionPoint: provider cost arrives after the original operation terminal
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: CostTraceV2 reconciliation or finding receipt
faults.recovery: bind to the original operation or record an unattributed finding

faults.injectionPoint: Control Plane event consumer stops acknowledging
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: bounded overflow signal and durable checkpoint preservation
faults.recovery: resume from the last durable consumer checkpoint

faults.injectionPoint: daemon receives signal or stdin EOF while mutations are active
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: daemon shutdown terminal receipt or recovery_required
faults.recovery: drain through the shared shutdown mutation gate

faults.injectionPoint: canonical command effect commits before client acknowledgement
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: original bounded command effect replay
faults.recovery: read authority command journal and never execute twice

faults.injectionPoint: proposal or HumanGate adapter is composed with a different command journal generation or shutdown gate
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: adapter_contract_violation before daemon transport accepts requests
faults.recovery: recompose the exact Runtime services with the daemon authority binding

faults.injectionPoint: remote executor effect starts and its acknowledgement is lost
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: reconciliation_required authority record
faults.recovery: operator reconciliation; automatic resubmission is forbidden

faults.injectionPoint: target accepts handoff before source fence or commit acknowledgement
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: persisted target receipt and target commit before source fence
faults.recovery: replay terminal event without transferring twice

faults.injectionPoint: sink accepts a batch before canonical delivery event acknowledgement
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: terminal sink receipt remains in durable spool
faults.recovery: append the delivery event without invoking the sink twice

faults.injectionPoint: forge creates a Draft PR before terminal event acknowledgement
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: terminal_pending provider receipt
faults.recovery: append the terminal event without creating another Draft PR

faults.injectionPoint: requester or proposal builder attempts to approve the HumanGate
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: human_gate_required or reconciliation_required without decided event
faults.recovery: obtain a server-scoped organization receipt and an independent principal decision

faults.injectionPoint: raw forensic content is offered to the default metadata spool
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: forensic_denied or schema rejection
faults.recovery: use the isolated encrypted forensic store with independent policy and retention

faults.injectionPoint: remote, telemetry or lifecycle receipt is replayed into another tenant
faults.expectedEventOrReceipt: scope_mismatch, not_found or handoff rejection
faults.recovery: resolve the authority-owned record in its original tenant only

faults.injectionPoint: session fork handoff checkpoint Episode Artifact legal-hold or writer-lease source is unavailable
